description: Scan recent Sent mail and recently-modified Notes for commitments you made ("I'll send you…", "I'll follow up…") and emit draft reminders with a confidence score. Read-only by default; set create=true to also create the reminders in a list. Slow (per-batch AI calls): under MCP the AI pass is bounded to ~50s and returns partial results with a timedOut warning: lower limit/days or run via job_run for an exhaustive scan.

account.description: Mail account to scan (default: all accounts).

api_key.description: API key for the Claude provider.

create.description: Create reminders from the extracted actions (side-effecting).

limit.description: Max items to scan per source (default: 50).

list.description: Reminder list name to create into (used when create=true).

mail.description: Include Sent mail as a source.

min_confidence.description: Minimum confidence (0.0-1.0) to include an action (default: 0.5).

notes.description: Include recently-modified Notes as a source.

provider.description: AI provider: ollama, claude, or openai (default: ollama).
